body:
**SUGGESTION:** Doc comment overstates the liveness re-check

'liveness is re-checked after each await rather than assumed' — the idle gate checks `live` only once, after the probe await. A `session.deleted` landing during the log/prompt awaits clears the gate but performs no liveness re-check; the in-flight re-prompt to the dead session still goes out (which the guard comment at the check accepts). Consider wording like 'liveness is re-checked after the probe await rather than assumed'.
